name: travel-planner
description: A three-column trip planner (trips, calendar, tasks) with shared team workspaces — Next.js, Prisma, Postgres.

paragraphs: A three-column trip planner — trips on the left, a month calendar in the middle, finances on the right — with per-trip Stay / Transport / Activities booking details. Multiple people can plan the same trip together: sign up, invite teammates by link, and everyone sees the same trips, bookings and costs.
Implemented from a Claude Design HTML/CSS/JS prototype; this is the real, database-backed version of that design.
features: Month calendar with multi-day trip bars (lane-packed so overlapping trips
never collide), holiday/note markers, and a responsive layout that collapses the side panels into icon rails at medium widths and a Trips/Calendar/Finances tab bar on mobile.

detail drawer with Stay, Transport, and Activities sections. Each entry is a name + booking link + cost, plus any number of attached PDFs (tickets, confirmations, receipts); once name, link and cost are filled in, the…
Finances panel: every booking across all stops, grouped into Stay,
Transport and Activities with per-category totals and share of the trip budget. Add expense creates a booking on any stop (with PDFs); clicking a line opens it in that stop's drawer for editing.
